questions.learningObjective: apply the doctrine of offer and acceptance to a concrete legal fact pattern
questions.stem: Consider this: A buyer emailing a supplier claims a contract was formed. The reply added a new term. Which statement best states the governing legal rule?

options.text: Any public advertisement is an offer that a buyer can accept by walking into the store in the case at hand.
options.misconception: treats every advertisement as an offer

options.text: A price estimate is an offer even when it clearly invites further discussion as applied here.
options.misconception: assumes price quotes are always offers

options.text: An invitation to treat is simply another name for a binding offer on the facts given.
options.misconception: confuses an offer with an invitation

options.text: An offer is a manifestation of willingness to enter a bargain that creates a reasonable expectation that assent will conclude it, rather than an invitation to negotiate in the present case.

questions.explanation: The test looks at the reasonable expectations created by the words and circumstances.
